            inv = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {

        int j = (ll)k * i % p;
        int m = inv;

        while (!seen[j]) {

            m = (ll)m * inv % p;
            j = (ll)k * j % p;
        }

        if (m == 1) ans = ans * p % MOD;
    }

    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
